The IMD's founding year: 30612 (meteorology as the systematic study behind all forecasting) is the only concept in this set that covers the discipline and its institution.
The IMD motto and the evaporation it refers to - the IMD/meteorology concept, 30612. The set has no water-cycle concept.
Why a rain gauge must stand clear of obstructions - siting, 30618.

Normal sea-level pressure of about 1013 mb. This chapter's 17 concepts include no pressure or barometer concept; 30609 (the atmosphere as a layer of air) is the genuine home of pressure as the weight of that air.
Wind as air moving from high to low pressure, with uneven (not uniform) heating: a property of the air layer in 30609. 30616 is the anemometer, an instrument, not the mechanism.
A wind vane showing direction: 30616 is this set's wind-instrument concept (anemometer for speed); no wind-direction concept exists, and the note records that gap.
A wind sock indicating direction at an airport - the wind-instrument concept, 30616.
Millibars on a barometer: an instrument-and-its-reading item, and 30618 is the concept that gathers the instruments of a weather station. No barometer concept exists in this set.
Pine cones closing in humid air is humidity made visible - 30617, the humidity concept, whose description is about how much water vapour the air holds.
'Water vapour' defined - the quantity a hygrometer measures, 30617.

Cold for a Chennai resident being pleasant for a Kashmiri sits in the chapter's temperature section, where what is felt is set against what a thermometer reads - 30614. No acclimatisation concept exists in the set.
Pine cones driven by humidity - 30617.
Evaporative cooling is the mechanism behind 30617's point that humidity is what makes a hot day feel oppressive or comfortable.
Matches four instruments to what each measures, which is 30618's claim that no single instrument captures the weather.
IMD motto fill-in - 30612.
Keyed on water vapour as invisible gas - 30617.
Animal behaviour as a traditional weather sign is 30613, where local observation is treated as evidence worth recording. DEFECT: statements 1-3 are missing from the stored stem.
Water vapour named - 30617.
The IMD's motto - 30612.
Pressure higher at sea level than on a mountain: the depth of the air layer above, 30609.
The barometer as the pressure instrument - the station's instrument set, 30618, for want of a barometer concept.
Millibar as the pressure unit - 30618, with the other instrument-and-unit items.
'Acclimatise' comes from the same passage as the Chennai/Kashmir comparison in the temperature section - 30614, and no acclimatisation concept exists.
Wind vane named - the wind-instrument concept, 30616.
AWS = Automated Weather Station, which is 30619 (a station that reads and transmits without an observer).
Clinical against laboratory thermometer is 30614's point that the same quantity has purpose-built instruments.
Pressure falling with altitude because the air column shortens - the air layer of 30609.
Breathlessness at altitude from thinner air - the same property of the air layer, 30609.
The IMD motto read against the water cycle - 30612.
Pressure differences producing wind - a property of the air layer, 30609, as with the assertion-reason twin.
